title: ISO 10791-6:2014 — Test conditions for machining centres — Part 6: Accuracy of speeds and interpolations
locator: Official catalogue abstract and Annex C: kinematic tests for machining centres with three linear axes and one or two rotary axes, including configurations with rotary tables; confirmed in 2026
notes: Concerns kinematic accuracy of speeds and simultaneous NC-axis interpolation on specified machining-centre configurations. It is not an isolated rotary table component test and excludes machine operating-condition checks such as vibration and abnormal noise. Full text is not archived.
